description: Restrict the Atp12 ortholog set to fungi (plus human as reference) and test conservation of the FMC1-binding face versus the ATP5F1A-binding face, with per-site Fisher tests on the S. pombe sequence and a figure.
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
D=os.getcwd(); M=os.path.join(D,'mitomatch')
s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
AA3=set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE'.split())
def parse(p):
    rows=[]
    for L in open(p):
        if L.startswith('ATOM') and L[76:78].strip()!='H' and L[17:20].strip() in AA3:
            rows.append((L[21],int(L[22:26]),float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['ch','ri','x','y','z'])
def iface(df,cA,cB):
    A=df[df.ch==cA]; Bc=df[df.ch==cB][['x','y','z']].values
    return pd.Series({ri: np.sqrt(((g[['x','y','z']].values[:,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min() for ri,g in A.groupby('ri')})
face_fmc1=sorted(iface(parse(os.path.join(M,'Q96HJ9_Q8N5M1.pdb')),'B','A')[lambda x:x<5.0].index)
face_alpha=sorted(iface(parse(os.path.join(M,'Q8N5M1_P25705.pdb')),'A','B')[lambda x:x<5.0].index)
hum=''.join(s.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8N5M1.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])

r=s.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={'query':'(family:"ATP12 family") AND (taxonomy_id:4751)','format':'tsv','size':300,
                'fields':'accession,organism_name,length,sequence'},timeout=120)
rows=[l.split('\t') for l in r.text.strip().split('\n')]
o=pd.DataFrame(rows[1:],columns=rows[0]); o['Length']=pd.to_numeric(o['Length'],errors='coerce')
o=o[(o.Length>200)&(o.Length<460)]
o['genus']=o['Organism'].str.split().str[0]
o=o.drop_duplicates('genus').reset_index(drop=True)
print("fungal ATP12 genera available:",len(o))
sel=pd.concat([o[o.Entry=='Q9UT16'], o[o.Entry!='Q9UT16']]).head(26).reset_index(drop=True)
print(list(sel['genus']))

AAi={c:i for i,c in enumerate("ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV")}
B=np.array([[4,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-1,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,0,-3,-2,0],[-1,5,0,-2,-3,1,0,-2,0,-3,-2,2,-1,-3,-2,-1,-1,-3,-2,-3],
[-2,0,6,1,-3,0,0,0,1,-3,-3,0,-2,-3,-2,1,0,-4,-2,-3],[-2,-2,1,6,-3,0,2,-1,-1,-3,-4,-1,-3,-3,-1,0,-1,-4,-3,-3],
[0,-3,-3,-3,9,-3,-4,-3,-3,-1,-1,-3,-1,-2,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1],[-1,1,0,0,-3,5,2,-2,0,-3,-2,1,0,-3,-1,0,-1,-2,-1,-2],
[-1,0,0,2,-4,2,5,-2,0,-3,-3,1,-2,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],[0,-2,0,-1,-3,-2,-2,6,-2,-4,-4,-2,-3,-3,-2,0,-2,-2,-3,-3],
[-2,0,1,-1,-3,0,0,-2,8,-3,-3,-1,-2,-1,-2,-1,-2,-2,2,-3],[-1,-3,-3,-3,-1,-3,-3,-4,-3,4,2,-3,1,0,-3,-2,-1,-3,-1,3],
[-1,-2,-3,-4,-1,-2,-3,-4,-3,2,4,-2,2,0,-3,-2,-1,-2,-1,1],[-1,2,0,-1,-3,1,1,-2,-1,-3,-2,5,-1,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],
[-1,-1,-2,-3,-1,0,-2,-3,-2,1,2,-1,5,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,1],[-2,-3,-3,-3,-2,-3,-3,-3,-1,0,0,-3,0,6,-4,-2,-2,1,3,-1],
[-1,-2,-2,-1,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,-1,-2,-4,7,-1,-1,-4,-3,-2],[1,-1,1,0,-1,0,0,0,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-2,-1,4,1,-3,-2,-2],
[0,-1,0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,5,-2,-2,0],[-3,-3,-4,-4,-2,-2,-3,-2,-2,-3,-2,-3,-1,1,-4,-3,-2,11,2,-3],
[-2,-2,-2,-3,-2,-1,-2,-3,2,-1,-1,-2,-1,3,-3,-2,-2,2,7,-1],[0,-3,-3,-3,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,3,1,-2,1,-1,-2,-2,0,-3,-1,4]],float)
def enc(q): return np.array([AAi.get(c,-1) for c in q])
def nw_fast(A,Q,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    ia,iq=enc(A),enc(Q); n,m=len(ia),len(iq); NEG=-1e9
    S=np.where((ia[:,None]>=0)&(iq[None,:]>=0), B[np.clip(ia,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(iq,0,19)[None,:]], -4.0)
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Tm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mx[0,0]=0.; Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); Tx[1:,0]=1; Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m); Ty[0,1:]=2
    ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        V=np.vstack([Mx[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]]); k=V.argmax(0)
        Mx[i,1:]=V[k,ar]+S[i-1]; Tm[i,1:]=k
        V=np.vstack([Mx[i-1,1:]+go,Ix[i-1,1:]+ge,Iy[i-1,1:]+go]); k=V.argmax(0); Ix[i,1:]=V[k,ar]; Tx[i,1:]=k
        mr=Mx[i]; xr=Ix[i]; yr=Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(mr[j-1]+go,xr[j-1]+go,yr[j-1]+ge); k=int(np.argmax(c)); yr[j]=c[k]; Ty[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); st=Tm[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: st=Tx[i,j]; i-=1
        else: st=Ty[i,j]; j-=1
    return pr[::-1]

cols={i:[] for i in range(1,len(hum)+1)}; pom={}; ids=[]
for _,row in sel.iterrows():
    q=row['Sequence']
    if not isinstance(q,str) or len(q)<200: continue
    pr=nw_fast(hum,q); idt=sum(1 for a,b in pr if hum[a]==q[b])/max(1,len(pr))
    if idt<0.14: continue
    ids.append((row['Entry'],row['Organism'][:40],round(idt,4)))
    for a,b in pr: cols[a+1].append(hum[a]==q[b])
    if row['Entry']=='Q9UT16': pom={a+1:q[b] for a,b in pr}; pom_id=idt
print(f"\n{len(ids)} fungal orthologs aligned to human ATPAF2, identity {min(i[2] for i in ids)*100:.1f}-{max(i[2] for i in ids)*100:.1f}%")

cons=pd.Series({i:(np.mean(v) if len(v)>=0.6*len(ids) else np.nan) for i,v in cols.items()})
grp=pd.Series('other',index=cons.index)
for r_ in face_alpha:
    if r_ in grp.index: grp[r_]='alpha_face'
for r_ in face_fmc1:
    if r_ in grp.index: grp[r_]='FMC1_face'
for r_ in set(face_fmc1)&set(face_alpha):
    if r_ in grp.index: grp[r_]='both'
print("\n--- ATPAF2 columns, conservation across fungi (identity to human) ---")
for g in ['FMC1_face','alpha_face','both','other']:
    v=cons[grp==g].dropna()
    if len(v): print(f"{g:11s} n={len(v):3d} mean={v.mean():.3f} median={np.median(v):.3f}")
a=cons[grp=='FMC1_face'].dropna(); b=cons[grp=='other'].dropna(); c=cons[grp=='alpha_face'].dropna()
dd=lambda x,y:(x.mean()-y.mean())/np.sqrt((x.var()+y.var())/2)
p1=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='two-sided').pvalue
p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(c,b,alternative='two-sided').pvalue
p3=stats.mannwhitneyu(c,a,alternative='greater').pvalue
print(f"\nFMC1_face vs other      p={p1:.4g} d={dd(a,b):+.2f}")
print(f"alpha_face vs other     p={p2:.4g} d={dd(c,b):+.2f}")
print(f"alpha_face vs FMC1_face p={p3:.4g} d={dd(c,a):+.2f}")

# S. pombe specific identity per face + Fisher
def cnt(res):
    rr=[x for x in res if x in pom]; k=sum(1 for x in rr if pom[x]==hum[x-1]); return k,len(rr)
oth=[i for i in range(1,len(hum)+1) if grp[i]=='other']
kf,nf=cnt(face_fmc1); ka,na=cnt(face_alpha); ko,no=cnt(oth)
print(f"\nS. pombe atp12 identity to human ATPAF2 overall {pom_id*100:.1f}%")
print(f"  FMC1 face  {kf}/{nf} = {kf/nf*100:.1f}%")
print(f"  alpha face {ka}/{na} = {ka/na*100:.1f}%")
print(f"  other      {ko}/{no} = {ko/no*100:.1f}%")
print("  Fisher FMC1face vs alphaface p=%.4g" % stats.fisher_exact([[kf,nf-kf],[ka,na-ka]])[1])
print("  Fisher FMC1face vs other     p=%.4g" % stats.fisher_exact([[kf,nf-kf],[ko,no-ko]])[1])

pd.DataFrame({'human_pos':cons.index,'human_aa':[hum[i-1] for i in cons.index],
              'pombe_aa':[pom.get(i,'-') for i in cons.index],'face':grp.values,
              'frac_identical_fungi':cons.values}).to_csv(os.path.join(D,'ATPAF2_face_conservation_fungi.csv'),index=False)
pd.DataFrame(ids,columns=['acc','organism','identity_to_human']).to_csv(os.path.join(D,'ATP12_fungal_ortholog_set.csv'),index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
data=[cons[grp=='FMC1_face'].dropna().values,cons[grp=='alpha_face'].dropna().values,cons[grp=='other'].dropna().values]
bp=ax[0].boxplot(data,labels=['FMC1 face\n(n=%d)'%len(data[0]),'alpha-F1 face\n(n=%d)'%len(data[1]),'other\n(n=%d)'%len(data[2])],showmeans=True,patch_artist=True)
for p,col in zip(bp['boxes'],['#4C72B0','#DD8452','#CCCCCC']): p.set_facecolor(col)
ax[0].set_ylabel('fraction of %d fungal orthologs identical to human'%len(ids))
ax[0].set_title('Atp12 surface conservation across fungi')
ax[1].bar([0,1,2],[kf/nf*100,ka/na*100,ko/no*100],color=['#4C72B0','#DD8452','#CCCCCC'])
ax[1].set_xticks([0,1,2]); ax[1].set_xticklabels(['FMC1 face\n%d/%d'%(kf,nf),'alpha-F1 face\n%d/%d'%(ka,na),'other\n%d/%d'%(ko,no)])
ax[1].set_ylabel('% identical, S. pombe atp12 vs human ATPAF2')
ax[1].set_title('S. pombe atp12 (Q9UT16) identity by face')
for i,v in enumerate([kf/nf*100,ka/na*100,ko/no*100]): ax[1].text(i,v+1,'%.1f%%'%v,ha='center')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
